top_reviews.title: Thank you!!
top_reviews.body: I’m on a certain medication that can cause weight gain. And for years, it hasn’t bothered me or my weight at all. But in the past year I’ve gained so much weight that I don’t have 1 pair of jeans that actually fit. I’m only 5’3 so if they fit me in the length, I can’t button ‘em & vice versa. So I started looking at stretchy jeans & they were everywhere. I had no idea which ones to get. Until I found these KUNMI Women High Waist Skinny Stretch Ripped Jeans. They were absolutely beautiful & the video showed me everything I needed to know. When they got here, I immediately tried them on & couldn’t believe it took me so long to buy them. All those hours, days, months, years of looking in the mirror & not wanting to leave the house because of how I looked could’ve been saved by just one order. It says to buy a size smaller than your usual size so I bought the Color: 001-dark Blue in a size Large & they were a little big in the waist. Not much. But they looked amazing on & I could actually move. And after I washed & dried them, they shrank just enough to fit perfectly. Plus they feel like they’re made of real jeans material not yoga pants. I’ll never order them from anywhere else. They would make a great gift for anytime. Definitely Recommend!! 5 Stars All Around!!

top_reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised!
top_reviews.body: I read a lot of the reviews so that I’d have a better understanding on what size pants I should order. I bought them in a size large and they fit me so nicely. I don’t typically wear jeans, I never liked having to button my pants up so I usually just wear leggings. I primarily dress for comfort. I absolutely loved the way they looked on me. My favorite part about these pants is that you don’t have to button or zip them up because the waist is stretchy and you can tie them however tight you’d want the waist area to be. I don’t feel restricted in these pants, they’re not too long and they’re not too short either. I’m 5’6 and weigh approximately 170lbs so I’m very glad I went with a size large. I definitely recommend getting these jeans and order them in your actual size. I don’t see a reason why you’d have to size up with these jeans. I want to get them in other colors! EDIT: To add an update: So I’ve bought these pants in most of the colors they offer and I still love them. They are easily on my list of favorite jeans to wear. They are just so comfortable, I can squat down and the jeans move with me because they’re so stretchy! Absolutely fantastic jeans :)

top_reviews.title: They run a lil big.. Check the size guide
top_reviews.body: Ordered these in a very big size (4x) intentionally cos I wanted the effortlessly chic slouchy look.. Well...lol the fit was very big and not in a cute way.. They were not soft they were actually kinda stiff.. If they stretched I wouldn't know because I bought these unaware that they run a lil on the bigger side.. I did like the color..dark blue and distressed and the quality could've been better but I liked them.. Just gotta figure out what size to order to achieve the desired look I want.. Who knows maybe after I wash them they'll get softer🤷🏻‍♀️

top_reviews.title: Great jeans
top_reviews.body: The last few years I’ve learned I like pull on jeans better. Regular jeans dig into my stomach too much. These are perfect! They fit great and sit at a good height in the waist for me. For me they’re true to size. I’m usually an xl in pants and an xl in these for me give that “jegging” fit. I love the distressed look. My only complaint is they’re a tiny bit too long. I don’t like pants hitting right at my ankles. I like them just a bit higher. But I’m short so that’s a common problem with me and pants. For reference, I’m 5’2” and about 190lbs. I’m Will definitely be buying the other colors!
